text:
Which statement about reactions is correct?
A
A reaction that is vigorous at room temperature has a high activation energy.
If ΔH for a reaction is positive, bond making in the formation of the products is endothermic.
B
C
In an exothermic reaction, the energy required to break bonds is less than the energy
released to make bonds.
D
Reactions with a positive enthalpy change always transfer thermal energy to the
surroundings.
